Name: Witch Hats (Fashion Sense)
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/612]Witch Hats[/url] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], allowing access from the[url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool] Hand Mirror[/url].
Includes all original hats, and adds colourable and prismatic versions.

Made with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4632040]7yrsofbadluck[/url].
